scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build:app && npm run build -w server && npm run dist:mac -w desktop
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build:app && npm run build -w server && npm run dist:win -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:app && npm run build -w server && npm run prepare-app -w desktop && npm start -w desktop
